market.question: Will Silver (SI) hit (LOW) $60 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Silver trading ~$79-80 on May 7-8 2026. To dip to $60 by end of June would require ~25% drop in ~7-8 weeks. Strong bullish positioning and analyst targets. Such a sharp drawdown from current levels is unlikely. Estimate ~8-10%.
